summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests cemiplimab, an immune checkpoint inhibitor, before surgery in adults with resectable stage II to IIIB non-small cell lung cancer. Cemiplimab is given by IV infusion every 3 weeks, for at least 3 doses before surgery, with a possible 4th dose depending on scans after cycle 2. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa cemiplimab, un inhibidor de puntos de control inmunitario, antes de la cirugía en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas en estadio II a IIIB que puede resecarse. Cemiplimab se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas, al menos 3 dosis antes de la cirugía, con una posible cuarta dosis según los estudios de imagen después del ciclo 2. La medida de resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Stage II to IIIB(N2) non-small cell lung cancer considered resectable before systemic therapy
PD-L1 tumor proportion score of 50% or higher
Tumor reviewed by a multidisciplinary thoracic tumor board before enrollment
not_for: Locally advanced unresectable or stage IV (metastatic) disease
Large-cell neuroendocrine or small cell carcinoma histology, including mixed histology
Known sensitizing EGFR mutations or ALK translocation
Prior anti-PD-(L)1, anti-CTLA-4, or other T-cell co-regulatory antibody therapy
